character: Historic regional capital of the Belleville valley at 1,450m. Baroque architecture, authentic Savoyard village with narrow streets, stone houses, 16th-century church. La Bouitte (Michelin-starred). Ski access via gondola. Quiet, traditional atmosphere.
dining: La Bouitte (Michelin-starred, René Meilleur). Traditional Savoyard restaurants. Village cafes with sunny terraces.
shopping: Local shops, bakery, butchery, grocery, post office, pharmacy, sports rental.
apres_scene: Quiet village apres. Local bars, cafes. Far quieter than Les Menuires or Val Thorens.
activities_nearby: Ski via gondola to St-Martin piste area. Snowshoeing, hiking, heritage visits. Free shuttle to Les Menuires and Val Thorens.
